claim: Whole-run pace averages hide scene-specific costs, so measure rooms, transitions and actor modes separately and report slow updates, drift and largest excursion as separate numbers.

evidence.text: Opening-room timings missed a room-transition penalty; bench original-recording room starts separately, at the player draw call, with state equality and repeated quiet/busy trials.
evidence.quote: Opening-room timings missed a room-transition penalty.

evidence.text: A room at 28 MHz needs its original time back: fit over all rooms, then wait at the game's clock.
evidence.quote: A room at 28 MHz needs its original time back: a fit over all rooms, then a wait at the game's clock

evidence.text: A fixture beginning in a duel or busy-looking death is not a sustained live scene; split windows by actor type/mode and keep cold/death paths separate.
evidence.quote: A fixture beginning in a duel or busy-looking death is not a sustained live scene. Split windows by actor type/mode

evidence.text: A room entry costs about 0.2 s more than the original before the limiter repays it.
evidence.quote: a room entry costs about 0.2 s more than the original before the limiter repays it.

evidence.text: A rare per-update water strip invokes 22 direct glyph hooks in one room; measure every room.
evidence.quote: A rare per-update water strip invokes 22 direct glyph hooks. Measure every room;

evidence.text: The first pace check counted a steady drift of 0.07% as "13 frames ahead"; steady drift and bursts are two numbers.
evidence.quote: The first pace check counted a steady drift of 0.07% as "13 frames ahead": steady
